title: Mathematics Practice Test 2 - Mathematics - Fractions and Conversions
subject: Mathematics

questions.q: It takes Collin 24 minutes to walk to school in the morning. What fraction of his 24-hour day is spent walking to school in the morning?
questions.explain: First, convert his 24-hour day into minutes: $24 \text{ hours} \times 60 \text{ minutes/hour} = 1,440 \text{ minutes}$. The fraction of his day spent walking is $\frac{24}{1,440}$. Simplifying this fraction yields $\frac{1}{60}$.
